---
title: "Classe Quarta"
listing:
  contents: lezioni
  type: table
  fields: [date, tipo, title, subtitle]
  field-display-names:
    tipo: "Type"
    subtitle: "Driving question"
  sort: "date asc"
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
---

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing a").forEach(a => {
    a.target = "_blank";
    a.rel = "noopener";
  });
  // voci del listing mostrate ma non cliccabili (solo il titolo, senza link)
  const senzaLink = ["2026-11-09-ripasso-examination-week"];
  document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing a.listing-title").forEach(a => {
    if (senzaLink.some(slug => a.getAttribute("href").includes(slug))) {
      const span = document.createElement("span");
      span.className = a.className;
      span.textContent = a.textContent;
      a.replaceWith(span);
    }
  });
});
</script>
